title: Measure the first 30 seconds after a start and a seek of a shared re-encode, on a quiet machine, with helpers started late and at once
description: JS-168's two workers held a shared 4K HDR re-encode at 1.00x, but a freeze over 2 s came in 9 of 18 parts, all within the first 21 s after a first frame, on a machine at load average 5 to 33. Whether that is the machine or the product, and whether asking for helpers at the start and the seek shortens it, is measured here; nothing is weakened meanwhile (D-051).
acceptanceCriteria: On a quiet machine: load average under 1 with the harness stopped before each run, and no more than 1 above the harness's own during it. A run outside that is discarded and repeated, and every run's load is recorded. If the developer machine cannot be made quiet, it returns to the product owner as a brief (D-065)
Two 2-CPU workers as in JS-168, in jellyfin-web, without a subtitle and with the PGS track burned in: play 60 seconds, seek to the middle, play 60 seconds; 10 trials of each

For each part: time to first frame, each freeze's start and length, the longest freeze, the player's buffered lead at each freeze, and when the first helper's first segment was stored, counted from the first frame
The same 10 trials with a helper asked for at the job's start and at the seek, not after the job is judged slow. The rule is lifted for the measurement only and nothing is merged
The same two rows on a 2-CPU and a 6-CPU worker, 5 trials each
Recorded in docs/transcoding.md with machine and command; no film title, path or host name
The figures come to the product owner as a brief, with keeping the 2 s bound among the options and each option priced
notes: What each result decides (D-051): as built, no freeze over 2 s in 20 of 20 parts on the quiet machine: the bound is met, the record says so and docs/status.md's gap line closes citing D-051. As built it misses and with helpers at the start it is met in 20 of 20: JS-161 part (b) gains "A play admitted as shared has its helpers asked for at its start and at each seek, not after it is judged slow; on two throttled workers no freeze over 2 seconds in the first 30 seconds of a start or a seek, 10 of 10 (D-051)." It misses both ways: back to the product owner as a brief, with holding the first frame priced from a measurement of how far the server can steer jellyfin-web's buffering. Built beside JS-161 and never holds its merge. JS-166's record (tasks/done.json) holds the first-30-seconds figures of its eight seeks at a CPU limit of 8, for this task (D-064, D-065). Dropped 2026-11-24 (D-073): no deployment plays a shared re-encode, and its rig is refused the play since JS-177. D-051's bound is kept; the measurement returns by D-073's conditions (BL-275).
